items.title: Amii researcher Ross Mitchell secures $1-million CIHR grant for AI tool to advance IBD care
items.summary: Amii Fellow and Canada CIFAR AI Chair Ross Mitchell and a team at the University of Alberta have secured a new $1-million grant from Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR) to develop and test new AI tools that could help physicians diagnose and monitor inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), like Crohn’s disease.

items.title: From legal scarcity to legal abundance: Benjamin Alarie on Superjustice
